description: Facets of a category PLP: for each listed facet attribute (IsFacets) its label and values with product counts in the category (a parent counts via its children), and the products of the first value of the first attribute. Read only.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

categoryId.description: Category the test opens (ZnodePublishCategoryEntity.ZnodeCategoryId): link it to @category.categoryId

attributeCodes.description: Comma-separated facet attribute codes in the order the test reads them (ZnodePimAttribute.AttributeCode, e.g. SpoutType,PlumbingPartsMaterial,ToeStyle); at most 3

minValuesPerAttribute.description: Fewest values with products in the category each listed attribute must have (the values the test reads, at most 3)

minProductsForValue.description: Fewest products the first value of the first attribute must filter the PLP to

maxProductsForValue.description: Most products that filter may show (the filtered products the test checks, at most 3)
